2019-easter-event-starting-the-2019-east.npc: Oh no, why today of all days?
I'm having an eggceptionally bad day. But if you must know, my Egg making machine is shell dry and the next shipment of fuel will not be here for a while!
I would love it if a cracking adventurer, such as yourself, would help a Bunny in need.

2019-easter-event-starting-the-2019-east.prompt: Will you help the Easter Bunny?

steps.player: I would love to help you mix up some more fuel.

steps.npc: Thanks for eggreeing to help me.
There are three ingredients that are needed to make the fuel.
The first ingredient is Dried cocoa. During any other time of year this ingredient would be eggceptionally hard to get.
But if I'm spot on with my information, there should be a merchant rolling into Al Kharid soon. He should sell you some.
Try not to bring me camel dung, they do look similar.
The second ingredient is really high quality milk.
The most eggceptional milk around has got to be milk from Hosidius, I'm sure Duke Horacio's cook can help you out.
The third ingredient is some cracking spices, very special ones. Can't go into detail, trade secret and all.
I'm sure if you talk to Martin in Draynor, he'll be a good egg and help you out if you ask for Special spices.
Since you're doing errands for me. Feel Free to use my tunnels to get around.
But don't make a yolk out of it, you may only use each tunnel once. Can't have you interrupting my workers any more than that.
Also, if you ever forget what you need, there will be a worker nearby who can remind you.

steps.player: I'll get right on it. Be back soon.

steps.npc: See you soon!

steps.player: Get stuffed.

steps.npc: I'll have you know this is no yolking matter.

options.text: Where do I get the Dried cocoa?

steps.player: Where do I get the Dried cocoa?

steps.npc: During any other time of year this ingredient would be a nightmare to get.
But if I'm spot on with my information, there should bea merchant making his way from the Kharidian Desert to Al Kharid.
I'd suggest checking the Shantay Pass.

options.text: Where do I get the bottle of Hosidius milk?

steps.player: Where do I get the bottle of Hosidius milk?

steps.npc: The most eggceptional milk around has got to be milk from Hosidius, I'm sure Duke Horacio's cook in Lumbridge castle can help you out.

options.text: Where do I get the Special spices?

steps.player: Where do I get the Special spices?

steps.npc: I'm sure if you talk to Martin in Draynor, he'll be a good egg and help you out if you ask for Special spices.
He should get the hint.

steps.player: Goodbye.

steps.npc: Keep on rolling my friend!

when-first-spoken-to-after-starting-the-.player: Easter Bunny! I knew I would find you here.

when-first-spoken-to-after-starting-the-.npc: Easter Bunny... Now there's a name I haven't heard in a long time...

when-first-spoken-to-after-starting-the-.player: What have people been calling you instead?

when-first-spoken-to-after-starting-the-.npc: Many times have I walked past Varrock West Bank and been called 'Sellin lobbies 200gp'.
I don't really understand that one.

when-first-spoken-to-after-starting-the-.player: Do you think perhaps they weren't talking to you?

when-first-spoken-to-after-starting-the-.npc: Who could blame them? I'm a failure!

when-first-spoken-to-after-starting-the-.player: Oh come on now, what do you mean?

when-first-spoken-to-after-starting-the-.npc: You call me the Easter Bunny? What right do I have to that name?
I don't feel the spirit of Easter within me.
I'm just a big dumb rabbit!

when-first-spoken-to-after-starting-the-.text: The Easter Bunny is clearly very upset and needs cheering up. Perhaps the other people in the Rabbit Hole have some ideas?

when-spoken-to-a-second-time.player: Hello Easter Bunny, how are you feeling?

when-spoken-to-a-second-time.npc: Maybe I'll make my way through this sorry old world as a clown...

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-bowley-mol.speaker: Bowley Moley
cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-bowley-mol.text: Hello! Have you come to take part in the festivities?

options.text: The Easter Bunny is looking awfully glum this year.

steps.player: The Easter Bunny is looking awfully glum this year.
Perhaps we can help raise the Easter spirits?

steps.speaker: Bowley Moley
steps.text: You want to do some necromancy... To cheer up the Easter Bunny?

steps.player: No no no! It's just a figure of speech.
I just wonder if we could do anything to help.

steps.speaker: Bowley Moley
steps.text: Leave it to me boss.

steps.speaker: Bowley Moley
steps.text: I happen to know the E.B. is a big fan of bowling. In fact, he used to be a wizard on the lanes. A champion!

steps.speaker: Bowley Moley
steps.text: I also happen to have the ability to...

steps.speaker: Bowley Moley
steps.text: ...Rig the game in his favour.

steps.speaker: Bowley Moley
steps.text: Which is handy, he's very out of practise nowadays.

steps.player: Won't he suspect something?

steps.speaker: Bowley Moley
steps.text: Oh no! You see, I have these gears set up just here.

steps.speaker: Bowley Moley
steps.text: Wait, are you just trying to get my trade secrets?

steps.player: This is strictly a humanitarian effort!
Bun-itarian..?
Look, I just want to get Easter back on track.
You can keep your hustle going, I just want to help the Easter Bunny.

steps.speaker: Bowley Moley
steps.text: Oh alright, since I do owe the big softie. But I've got my whiskers on you!
Small cutscene ensues...

steps.npc: So, what is it you wanted to show me, [player name]?

steps.player: Well, Bowley here let me in on your secret. Bowling champion three years in a row.

steps.npc: Oh. Those were the days, I haven't partaken for while now though...
I just haven't had the spring in my step with my egg responsibilities.

steps.player: Well, here's your chance!

steps.npc: What do you mean? It's hardly fun without decent competition.
And nobody here quite likes bowling.

steps.speaker: Bowley Moley
steps.text: They what now?

steps.speaker: Bowley Moley
steps.text: I've only just gone and spent ages digging out this place and installing the machinery!

steps.player: Nothing to worry about I'm sure!

steps.npc: Ah Bowley, it is good to see you again.

steps.speaker: Bowley Moley
steps.text: Long Ears Johnson. Come to terrorise me pins again?

steps.player: We'll see about that.

steps.npc: Oh yes, [player name] is apparently quite good.
It's been so long since I've had a decent set with a worthy opponent.

steps.player: Chin up bucko, I'm here and ready to challenge your rule of these alleys!

steps.npc: Well, I suppose I'm not doing anything else. Why not?

steps.text: The player bowls down 3 carrot pins.

steps.npc: A fine shot, but not quite enough!
Watch this!

steps.text: Thunk
The Easter Bunny bowls a strike.

steps.player: A lucky strike?
I'd better shape up or this will be quite one sided.
And that would be no fun at all.

steps.text: Clang
The player bowls down the middle 6 pins.

steps.npc: Ah, so you have some fight in you.

steps.player: I could do this all day.

steps.npc: That's exactly what I wanted to hear!

steps.text: The screen fades black with the text "Some time later..."

steps.npc: I'm surprised I hadn't heard about your prowess before, [player name].

steps.player: Ah you know me, the most modest adventurer in Gielinor.

steps.npc: Ah, well I suppose I should pack it in while I'm ahead.
But we should do this again.

steps.speaker: Bowley Moley
steps.text: Aye we should! Also if you could get the word out about my establishment, I'll be raking it in!

steps.speaker: Bowley Moley
steps.text: I mean... The Rabbit Hole will enjoy all the visitors?

steps.player: Well, anyway...
It was a close match. How are you feeling now?

steps.npc: Oh it was fun but I think I'm just going to sit in the Rabbit Hole a bit longer.
I should be off. Always a pleasure, Bowley.

steps.speaker: Bowley Moley
steps.text: Aye, till next time.

talking-to-the-easter-bunny-after-bowlin.player: Hello Easter Bunny, how are you feeling?

talking-to-the-easter-bunny-after-bowlin.npc: I feel less horrible I suppose...

using-a-fancy-carrot-on-the-easter-bunny.player: Hey Bunny, would you like a fancy carrot?

using-a-fancy-carrot-on-the-easter-bunny.npc: Not really, I've eaten a lot of carrots recently.

talking-to-the-easter-bunny-while-holdin.player: Hello! I have a surprise for you.

talking-to-the-easter-bunny-while-holdin.npc: Oh? A surprise? It's not something horrible I hope.

talking-to-the-easter-bunny-while-holdin.player: Oh no, it's something quite delicious actually.
A lovely mug of carrot juice!
Don't worry, this is fancy carrot juice. I made it myself with some fantastic carrots.

talking-to-the-easter-bunny-while-holdin.npc: You made it? Well in that case I suppose I might give it a try. As long as Wheeler hasn't been near it.

talking-to-the-easter-bunny-while-holdin.player: I made sure of that. Go on!

talking-to-the-easter-bunny-while-holdin.npc: That was delicious, nothing like the usual slop.
Thank you, [player name], I really needed that.

talking-to-the-easter-bunny-while-holdin.player: How are you feeling now? Any better?

talking-to-the-easter-bunny-while-holdin.npc: Hmm... I'm feeling a bit more hopeful. Like spring is about to, well, spring! But I'm not sure if Easter is really my thing any more.

talking-to-the-easter-bunny-while-holdin.player: I'm sure I can help you remember how wonderful it is.

talking-to-the-easter-bunny-after-giving.player: Hello Easter Bunny, how are you feeling?

talking-to-the-easter-bunny-after-giving.npc: Hmm... I'm feeling a bit more hopeful. Like spring is about to, well, spring! But I'm not sure if Easter is really my thing any more.

talking-to-the-easter-bunny-after-giving.player: I'm sure I can help you remember how wonderful it is.

trying-to-talk-to-easter-bunny-with-east.player: Hmmm... I should check in with Eggus before I give one of these buns to the Easter Bunny. Quality control or something.

talking-to-the-easter-bunny-after-having.player: Hi! I'm back with an Easter treat, just for you.

talking-to-the-easter-bunny-after-having.npc: Special eh? Why would you give me something special?
I don't know if I deserve anything.

talking-to-the-easter-bunny-after-having.player: Here, it's an Easter bun. Fresh out of the oven.

talking-to-the-easter-bunny-after-having.npc: An Easter bun? I like those!
Yum! That was lovely. Thanks, [player name].

talking-to-the-easter-bunny-after-having.player: You are most welcome. Do you feel a bit more Easter- ey now?

talking-to-the-easter-bunny-after-having.npc: Oh, I'm starting to remember now! Easter is great! But I just... Hmm, I don't know...
I feel like I need one more little treat before I do anything to help with Easter.

talking-to-the-easter-bunny-after-having.player: Alright, let me think of something.

talking-to-the-easter-bunny-after-having.text: If the player has not talked to Fry yet:

steps.speaker: Fry
steps.text: Excuse me, [player name], I believe I can help you.

steps.player: Oh?

steps.speaker: Fry
steps.text: Come here!

steps.speaker: Fry
steps.text: I couldn't help overhearing that you're trying to cheer up the Easter Bunny, and I have an idea.

steps.player: Well that's sort of nosey, but go on.

steps.speaker: Fry
steps.text: Let's put on a performance! that will cheer him up.

steps.player: A performance?

steps.speaker: Fry
steps.text: Yes! He's always enjoyed a good show.

steps.player: Well I suppose that could work...

steps.speaker: Fry
steps.text: I have some classic material we can try if that sounds appropriate?

steps.player: I don't see why not.

steps.speaker: Fry
steps.text: Excellent! I've already talked to some of the other fellows in here about it too. They seem keen!
(Rehearsal cutscene begins.)

talking-to-the-easter-bunny-after-having.text: If the player has talked to Fry already:

steps.player: I wonder how Fry is getting on with that performance...

steps.npc: What was that?

steps.player: Oh, nothing. I just need to talk to Fry about something.

steps.npc: Oh, see you later then.

steps.text: (Continues with Fry dialogue.)

easter-bunny-after-cheered-up-two-times.npc: One more treat and I'll be ready to work on Easter again.

talking-to-the-easter-bunny-after-the-pe.npc: That dance was amazing! Well done. I feel so... Invigorated!

talking-to-the-easter-bunny-after-he-men.npc: Lawks! Look at the time, I should get back to Varrock to set up the Eggs!

talking-to-the-easter-bunny-near-varrock.text: If the player has no inventory space:

steps.text: You need [1-5] free inventory [slots/slot] to receive your Easter event rewards.

steps.npc: I have something fun for you, [player name]!
Come back when you have more space.

talking-to-the-easter-bunny-near-varrock.npc: Thanks for saving our bacon and eggs again, [player name]!

talking-to-the-easter-bunny-near-varrock.text: You've completed the Easter event: One glum bunny

talking-to-the-easter-bunny-near-varrock.player: Oh it's always my pleasure to get these delicious eggs!
I mean... to help out a friend in need!
Isn't it strange something always happens around this time of year that needs me to come and save the day?

talking-to-the-easter-bunny-near-varrock.npc: Oh really? I don't keep track, so much to do around now.

talking-to-the-easter-bunny-near-varrock.player: Oh well, I expect I'll be seeing you again next year.

talking-to-the-easter-bunny-near-varrock.npc: Would you please stop [player name], I'ts very hard to rush back here so fast.

talking-to-the-easter-bunny-near-varrock.player: You're coming back here, whenever I do?

talking-to-the-easter-bunny-near-varrock.npc: Precisely, so we'd all appreciate it if you didn't.
Who knows what you'd get up to down here on your own.
